svg.title: A VM reads a secret from Key Vault with a managed identity
svg.desc: Step 1: you, with the role Key Vault Secrets Officer, create a demo secret in the key vault in the resource group rg-azb-lab. Step 2: the Windows VM asks its local identity endpoint at 169.254.169.254 for a token. Step 3: Microsoft Entra ID issues the token for the VM system-assigned managed identity. Step 4: the VM sends the token to the key vault, which allows the read because the VM identity has the role Key Vault Secrets User, and returns the secret value. No password is stored on the VM.
svg.text: Role for the VM on this vault
4 read the secret with the token
No password, key or secret is stored on the VM.
